model.costScope: Whole recipient resource-cost denominator, including separately disclosed donated services; low-confidence judgment of its combined clinical health portfolio for LA and Orange County residents. Not measured patient outcomes, a cash-only donation return, a surgery-only price, or a complete societal analysis. Non-health benefits and unmeasured partner/patient costs are not valued.
model.geographicAttribution: LA MSA comprises Los Angeles and Orange counties, not Riverside or San Bernardino. Listed fixed-clinic schedules imply approximately 99 local weekly hours and 42.4 outside; the medical page additionally lists 12 Riverside mobile hours, lowering the proxy to about 64%. g=.65 is a rounded judgment, not observed residence or current throughput: the medical page mixes historical statistics, surgery is concentrated in Orange, and cross-county patients and variable staffing remain unknown. No population-share shortcut.
model.formula: For branch j, q_j = u_j * (1-exp(-(ln(1+d)+m+rho_j)*T_j))/(ln(1+d)+m+rho_j). q=sum(w_j*q_j). At annual full-resource normalization E: delivered=N*b, effective=N*b*e; Q_all=N*b*(e*q-h); Q_LA=g*Q_all. Price=10*E/Q_LA only if Q_LA>0. Benefits begin at completed treatment t=0, with continuous discounting equivalent to annual d, continuous mortality hazard m and decay rho. A delayed start requires an additional discount/survival factor and is not silently credited.
model.counterfactual: Existing insurance/emergency/other clinic access and Hoag/public grants continue. e is the fraction of added packages with consequential effective care beyond that alternative, not funding leverage. b is the separate net funding-to-throughput response after substitution, reserves and volunteer bottlenecks, applied once. Finite T concerns how long the successful package differs from its alternative; shorter alternative waits are stressed.
model.attribution: One patient-equivalent receives one primary clinical package; weights sum to one. Repeated visits, screenings, glasses and surgeries are not added as separate people or outcomes. No avoided mortality is separately credited. The generic harm/access burden is applied to all added packages, including those without benefit. Cash response is a conservative judgment on a full-resource cost normalization, not a measured grant production function.
model.uncertainty: Very low confidence in the clinical and marginal parameters. Mix weights, utility changes, duration, decay, mortality, burden, local share and cash response are explicit subjective priors; trials establish plausibility and counterfactual dependence rather than calibrating these values. Costs are original-return-derived, but service valuations and the post-opening cost trajectory are uncertain. Non-health benefits are omitted; externally paid and patient resources are incompletely priced.
model.nativeOutcomes: At normalization: 3500 added packages; 1225 effective packages; 796.25 local effective packages. Cost per delivered/effective/local effective package is 2081.100857142857/5946.0024489795915/9147.696075353218 USD. These prospective equivalents are not an observed surgery yield or an additional count on top of the reported patients.

inputs.name: E
inputs.rationale: Derived 2024 Part IX + events + separately disclosed donated-service expense; no claim of independent audit or current 2026 cost.

inputs.name: N
inputs.rationale: Carryforward of the 2024 over-10,000 patient claim; deduplication and current output unverified.

inputs.name: e
inputs.rationale: Alternative care, incomplete treatment and low-benefit encounters reduce consequential yield.

inputs.name: b
inputs.rationale: Ordinary additional support may substitute for partners/reserves or fail to unlock clinical hours.

inputs.name: g
inputs.rationale: Fixed-site hours plus Riverside mobile activity are a weak capacity proxy, not beneficiary residence.

inputs.name: branches
inputs.unit: exclusive package weights and finite utility parameters
inputs.rationale: Medical 65%, dental 18%, vision 15%, surgery 2% are not observed mix. Utilities, duration and decay are independent analyst judgments; the trials do not supply these numeric inputs.

inputs.name: d
inputs.rationale: Conventional rate expressed continuously as ln(1.03).

inputs.name: m
inputs.rationale: Competing-mortality simplification across unknown ages; no avoided deaths separately credited.

inputs.name: h
inputs.rationale: Treatment complications, travel and access burden net penalty on successful and unsuccessful packages alike; not an observed adverse-event rate.

sensitivity: Joint poor/favorable scenarios are illustrative judgment combinations, not confidence intervals or probability-weighted bounds. Zero throughput yields zero health, while treatment without benefit can produce harm.
The finite clinical bridge and cash responsiveness dominate; a new facility or the target of 2,000 mobile exams does not establish either.
A short-wait scenario caps all conditional benefits at three months; a zero-surgical-benefit scenario retains its weight but assigns no benefit rather than reallocating it favorably.
Cash-only and 50%/150% donated-value scenarios distinguish gift accounting from resource costs; no automatic volunteer multiplier is applied.
N=5,000 tests duplication; local share zero and broad .4/.9 joint cases test resident attribution. Costs 50% higher test the post-center financial gap.
